description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.
About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Our backend engineers sit at the core of how Robinhood works — powering the financial products that millions of people rely on every day. We build and scale the services, infrastructure, and data systems behind brokerage, crypto, payments, and more. We move fast, hold high standards, and solve problems that actually matter — at a scale that very few engineers ever get the chance to touch.

As a Software Engineering Intern, Backend, you won't be on the sidelines — you'll own a meaningful project end-to-end, from initial scoping through to production. You'll be embedded on a real team, working directly with experienced engineers, diving deep into how the US financial system actually operates, and shipping software that meets the correctness and scale requirements of a live financial platform. This is a summer where you'll leave with real impact to show for it!

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, Bellevue, WA, or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you'll do

Own a high-impact backend project from initial scoping through launch — you'll drive the work, not just support it

Partner with a dedicated mentor who will guide you from onboarding through shipping, deepening your understanding of our tech stack and financial domain along the way

Design, build, test, and release software solutions that meet the correctness and scalability requirements of a real financial platform

Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Robinhood to solve critical problems that span the organization

Maintain and scale an existing codebase using technologies such as Python/Django, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Memcached, AWS, and Kubernetes

What you bring

Currently enrolled in a full-time, degree-seeking program with an expected graduation date of Winter 2027 or Spring 2028

Strong CS fundamentals and deep understanding of best coding practices

Solid communication skills and an ability to drive large projects forward in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment

Passion and interest in financial technology and building fintech products and services

Prior software engineering experience from internships, hackathons, or personal projects

Familiarity with Python/Django or Go, and an understanding of relational databases and transactions

What we offer

Market competitive compensation structure

Quarterly lifestyle wallet for personal wellness, learning and development, and more

Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not

Time away including company holidays, paid time off, and sick time

Lively office environment with catered meals, fully stocked kitchens, and geo-specific commuter benefits

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected hourly range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.
Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$60—$60 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

Our team fosters a collaborative, ownership-driven culture where every analyst directly influences business strategy and product direction.

As a Business Analyst Intern, you'll spend 12 weeks embedded within a team across our Money and Growth org, getting direct exposure to the metrics, stakeholders, and strategic priorities that drive Robinhood's core business. You'll own real work from day one and build the analytical and cross-functional skills that define our team. Top performers may be extended an offer to join our 18-month rotational Business Analyst program after graduation.

Get hands-on with a specific business area within Money and Growth, working directly with product, engineering, risk, or operations stakeholders on live priorities

Analyze business performance metrics and economic drivers to identify growth opportunities and optimize business outcomes

Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems across product strategy, pricing, user segmentation, and risk-return trade-offs

Partner with engineering, product, risk, and finance teams to execute key strategic initiatives and monitor program efficacy

Develop analytical models, dashboards, and presentations to inform decision-making and influence business direction

What you bring

Experience or coursework in business analysis, strategy, management consulting, financial services, or a quantitative analytical role

Strong proficiency in SQL and quantitative modeling techniques

Ability to synthesize complex quantitative findings into clear, actionable recommendations for cross-functional partners
